screenshots.description: iCare Enterprise EHR desktop application shown on an iMac: PATIENT HUB sidebar with patient list, top patient banner (provider Dr. Collins; tabs for Diagnosis/Team/Chronic/Location 2A Surgical ICU/Attending), navigation tabs (Care Sheet, Assessments, Care Plans, Problems, Reminders, Meds, Orders, Consults, Surgery), and main work area with Active Problems, Allergies/Adverse Reactions, Active Medications, Clinical Reminders, vitals, appointments, and recent lab results. Device-mockup composite from EHR directory; patient banner present but small.
